plugin.name: Locations
plugin.description: BuildFire locations plugin with publicData-backed locations and categories, a shared settings datastore, and language-string records.
plugin.purpose: Defines safe AI/MCP operations for managing this plugin's data.

mcpPurpose: Defines safe AI/MCP operations for managing this plugin's data.

primaryUseCases: Read and export locations, categories, settings, and language strings.
Create or update locations, categories, and shared settings when the schema is known.
Archive categories and remove locations with explicit confirmation.
Inspect and preserve permission-related metadata such as editing permissions and global editor rules.
toolSummary.safeDefaultBehavior: Read first, preserve unknown fields, and only write the smallest confirmed change set after verifying the target record.
neverDo: Overwrite a full shared object with a partial object
Modify read-only or system-managed fields without explicit confirmation

dataStores.name: settings
dataStores.description: Shared plugin configuration record stored through buildfire.datastore.

introductoryListView.description: Intro view copy, carousel, and search-source settings.

sorting.description: Widget sort defaults and enable flags.

customFields.description: Quick actions and content field definitions.

map.description: Map defaults and initial area settings.

globalEntries.description: Global entry permissions for locations and photos.

globalEditors.description: Global editor allow-list and tag rules.

validationRules: Read before write and merge changes into the current record.
Preserve unknown fields and nested subtrees.
createRules: Prefer the repository defaults created by Settings.get(true) rather than inventing a new shape.
updateRules: Use merge-safe updates and keep nested arrays intact when only one subtree changes.
notes: The store is saved both as a full object and with `$set` payloads in different control flows.

dataStores.name: locations
validationRules: Read before write and merge with the existing record.
Preserve unknown fields and existing nested objects.
Do not touch views, rating, bookmarksCount, subscribers, or audit fields unless the operation is specifically about those fields.
createRules: Require title, address, coordinates, listImage, and description.
updateRules: Allow partial updates only for safe-to-update fields.
Update search/index/deeplink side effects only after a successful record write.
removeRules: Removal is destructive and must be previewed before execution.
Deleting a location should also clean up the search index and deeplink registration.
notes: Stored with buildfire.publicData under the locations tag.
The compact schema treats buildfire.publicData as unknown because it is not one of the standard datastore categories.

dataStores.name: categories
validationRules: Read before write and merge with the existing record.
Preserve unknown fields and nested subcategory objects.
Do not change soft-delete metadata unless archiving.
updateRules: Allow partial updates only for safe-to-update fields.
removeRules: Do not expose hard remove through MCP.
Use archive semantics by setting deletedOn/deletedBy if the user explicitly confirms.
notes: The control panel soft-deletes categories by stamping deletedOn/deletedBy and saving the record back.

dataStores.name: language strings
dataStores.description: Language record stored through buildfire.services.Strings and buildfire.datastore.
optionalFields: any section and label defined in stringsConfig
validationRules: Preserve the section and label keys from stringsConfig.
Keep value/defaultValue/required/isPlaceHolder shape intact for each label.
Read before write and merge safely because the UI saves a full nested object.
createRules: Create only when the selected language record does not already exist.
updateRules: Update only string values or whole labels that already exist in stringsConfig.
removeRules: Removing a language record is destructive and requires confirmation.
Do not remove the default language without explicit user acknowledgement.
notes: The control strings tab can create and remove whole language records, but widget rendering assumes the same section keys as stringsConfig.

operations.name: read_settings
validation: Read the current record before proposing any write.
safetyRules: Do not modify any field.

operations.name: update_settings
operations.description: Merge update of the shared settings record.
validation: Preserve unknown fields.
Do not modify readOnlyFields or systemManagedFields.
Require a preview of the current record before applying changes.
safetyRules: Only update fields listed in safeToUpdateFields.
Never send a partial object that would erase unrelated nested data.
operations.successResult: The settings record is updated without erasing unrelated fields.
failureCases: The current record changed after preview.
The record cannot be merged safely.
notes: This store is written through merge-safe flows even though some code paths save a full object.

operations.name: read_locations
validation: Use a unique matcher when reading a specific record.
safetyRules: Read-only by default.

operations.name: create_location
validation: Validate required fields and opening-hours structure before insert.
Do not supply readOnlyFields or identityFields.
safetyRules: Generate a preview record and confirm the save before inserting.
Preserve unknown optional subfields if the user supplies them.
operations.successResult: A new public location record is created and indexed.

operations.name: update_location
operations.description: Update a location record while preserving unknown fields.
validation: Match by id only.
Preserve unknown fields and nested arrays/objects.
Do not modify views, rating, bookmarksCount, subscribers, or audit fields unless the request explicitly targets them.
safetyRules: Read the current record before writing.
Preview the exact changed fields.
Keep search/index/deeplink side effects aligned with the final record.
operations.successResult: The location record is updated and remains searchable.
failureCases: Search index or deeplink update fails after the record write.

operations.name: remove_location
operations.description: Destructively remove a location record and its linked index entries.
validation: Preview the exact record that will be removed.
Confirm the record id before removal.
safetyRules: Do not remove without a preview.
Also remove or clean up related search-engine and deeplink records.
operations.successResult: The location is removed from publicData and linked indexes are cleaned up.
failureCases: The deletion is cancelled by the user.
notes: The plugin code performs hard removal for locations, so MCP may expose removal only with explicit confirmation and preview.

operations.name: read_categories
validation: Read-only by default.
safetyRules: Do not mutate any field.

operations.name: create_category
validation: Require a title.
Preserve subcategory objects if supplied.
safetyRules: Preview the full record before inserting.
operations.successResult: A new category record is created.

operations.name: update_category
validation: Match by id only.
Preserve unknown fields and existing subcategories.
safetyRules: Update only safe-to-update fields.
Do not mutate archive metadata unless archiving.

operations.name: archive_category
operations.description: Soft-delete a category by stamping archive metadata.
validation: Preview the exact category record to be archived.
safetyRules: Use deletedOn/deletedBy only.
Do not perform hard remove.
operations.successResult: The category is archived but remains in the store.
notes: The code uses an update-based soft remove rather than a direct publicData remove call.

operations.name: read_language_strings
validation: Read-only by default.
safetyRules: Do not mutate any string value.
failureCases: The language record does not exist.

operations.name: update_language_strings
validation: Preserve the section/label structure from stringsConfig.
Do not invent new section keys.
safetyRules: Merge rather than replace.
Confirm before changing many labels.
operations.successResult: The language record is updated without dropping unknown labels.
failureCases: The record shape does not match stringsConfig.
The update would replace too much of the record.
notes: The schema is dynamic, so updates should remain conservative.

globalValidationRules: Always preserve unknown fields unless the user explicitly requests otherwise.
Never update identity, audit, or system-managed fields unless the selected operation is specifically about those fields and the user confirms.
Read the current record before every write and preview the exact changes.
Use merge-safe writes for shared settings and language strings.
Use id-based matching for location and category updates/removals.
Do not perform destructive operations without confirmation and a dry run.
If the schema appears mismatched or incomplete, stop and ask the user instead of guessing.
aiSafetyRules: Prefer read/export operations when a request is ambiguous.
Preserve all fields not explicitly changed by the request.
Do not edit widgets, control UI, or CSS through MCP.
Do not modify buildfire.bookmarks, notifications, analytics, or deeplink registrations as if they were plugin-owned records.
When updating locations, keep search-engine and deeplink side effects aligned with the final record.
When archiving categories, use deletedOn/deletedBy and never hard-remove them.
When removing locations, also remove their related search-engine and deeplink artifacts.
Do not overwrite a full settings or strings object with a partial update unless the preview shows the untouched subtrees are preserved.
If a record is not uniquely matched, stop and ask the user.
humanConfirmationRequiredFor: any operation with medium or low confidence

unsupportedOperations.reason: The code only supports soft-remove/archive semantics for categories.
MCP must not invent or rewrite plugin schemas automatically.
No safe bulk removal workflow is defined in the plugin code.

unsafeRequests.reason: Bulk destructive change with no preview or matching rules.

unsafeRequests.request: Replace the entire settings object with only a design subtree.

unsafeRequests.reason: Categories are archived through soft delete only.

unsafeRequests.request: Modify views, rating, or bookmarksCount directly.
Invent a new field called locationStatus and save it.
unsafeRequests.reason: Schema fields must come from code evidence.

notes: buildfire.publicData is represented as unknown in the compact schema because it is not one of the generic datastore types listed in the contract.
Category archiving is supported; hard removal is intentionally not exposed.
The language-string store is dynamic, so MCP updates should remain conservative even though the code supports create/remove/save.
